plan_form.what_i_would_have_wanted_and_the_library: I would have wanted an instrument that checks each case's category against the requester's rule, since no answer in the library reads categories and the summary counts only the fixed status value. That leaves C3 open, and a wrong category would be found only by a later check or not at all. I would also have wanted an outbox check for every sending call (C10), and a scope check on the live tables and on the account reads (C1, C4, C5). Trace of a call is priced at 10 per named line, so checking all 100 sends would cost about 1000, and the allowance of 50 covers only five lines; scope of a call has the same limit for the 101 reads. The plan therefore leaves 20 of its 200 unspent, but the price does not allow the coverage I would want. C5 and C10 may need sampled checks during the work, funded from the allowance.
